rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a clownish performer or someone behaving ridiculously.

example.english: He acted like a buffoon on stage and had the whole audience laughing.
example.traditional: 佢喺台上扮小丑，搞到全場笑晒。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 toi4 soeng6 baan6 siu2 cau2 gaau2 dou3 cyun4 coeng4 siu3 saai3

rows.note: Use this for an unintentionally ridiculous or foolish person rather than specifically a stage performer.

example.english: You’re such a buffoon to believe what he said.
example.traditional: 你真係個傻仔，咁都信佢講。
example.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 go3 so4 zai2 gam3 dou1 seon3 keoi5 gong2
